prompt: Build a ToDo app.  users should be able to create an account, log in, log out, recover lost password, etc.  once logged in a user should be able to add, edit, delete todo items, mark them done, etc. Make the UI very simple but professional looking

repairs.issue: Initial generated app used blocked native confirm(), making Delete a no-op
repairs.resolution: One live follow-up replaced it with an in-app confirmation; Builder generation instructions now prohibit native dialogs

repairs.issue: Image downloads used fixed total deadlines and recovery could duplicate a warm-pack request
repairs.resolution: Use stalled-I/O deadlines, share warming and retain bounded retries; covered by download regressions

repairs.issue: Absolute session expiry could stop active Codex work and direct requests did not restore saved authorization
repairs.resolution: Rolling idle leases, active-turn protection, direct saved-session restoration, SSE heartbeats and explicit 30-minute task timeout; clock-driven regressions and live credential resumption passed

limitations: Password recovery email is not configured in browser-local Supabase; the generated UI discloses no email delivery and the request is unavailable
Native folder testing was on the development machine, not the user device
Initial exact-prompt output required one Delete UI repair; it was not a first-attempt full-feature pass
The live run began before subsequent generation-instruction, status-message and gateway-session fixes; focused regression suites cover those changes
